# FAQ

**How do I use this??**

I'll be posting tutorials on my YouTube channel soon!
<https://www.youtube.com/@WhatDreamsCost/>

**Where do I download these models??**

There is a good list of models and download links here: <https://github.com/wildminder/awesome-ltx2?tab=readme-ov-file>

Also the latest v1.1 spatial upscaler can be found here: <https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3/tree/main>

The tiny vae (taeltx2_3.safetensors) is found here:
<https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/blob/main/vae/taeltx2_3.safetensors>

**I'm getting errors when running this workflow!**

Double check that you have all of the correct models loaded. This is using the newest version of 2x upscaler (v1.1). You can change it to the older one under the Model Loader.

**How can I support you?**

Help me get a job. I'm unemployed and literally broke. (seriously, i'll even scrub toilets for minimum wage)

Or follow me on my socials :)

widgets_values:
KSK LTX2.3 / 3.0 Prompt Relay Template

GLOBAL_PROMPT:
One continuous cinematic LTX-2.3 shot. Start with the main action. Then define subject identity, environment, lighting, camera behavior, audio/dialogue, and hard continuity locks.

LOCAL_PROMPTS:
[0-2.5s] Physical action, gaze, hands, lips, camera.
|
[2.5-5s] Development of motion and expression.
|
[5-7.5s] Peak action / emotional beat / dialogue phrase.
|
[7.5-10s] Controlled ending pose and continuity hold.

SEGMENT_LENGTHS:
Use comma-separated seconds or proportional segment lengths matching the local prompts.

NEGATIVE_PROMPT:
Use KSK_LTX2.3_UNIVERSAL_NEGATIVE_V1. Keep it style-neutral: it must work for realistic, anime, stylized, product, scene, dialogue, and non-human shots.

LoRA ORDER:
1 Base quantized LTX2.3 model
2 Distilled LoRA where applicable
3 VVR motion/visual base, never omit
4 OmniNFT / OmniCine identity-cinematic adapter
5 Branch adapter: Dual Character for two-person dialogue, Motion Track Control for single/non-dual motion
6 Crisp/detail enhancer where generation quality benefits
7 IC/Edit task LoRA: subtitles, watermark, upscale, outpaint, lipdub
8 LTX2_NAG with the universal negative prompt into video and audio NAG inputs

Close-up on the little boy inventor as he leans toward the guard with a huge confident smile. His mouth moves clearly and quickly, eyebrows bouncing as he says in a childish voice, "Uncle, uncle, listen! This tiny thing is super, super important!" He taps the brass gadget beside his cheek and gives an innocent grin. | The guard leans down and says firmly, "No ticket, no entry, little guy." The boy immediately shakes his head and talks faster, waving one hand while holding the gadget with the other. He says, "I'm not sneaking in! I'm saving the show! Well... maybe also watching a little bit." He smiles nervously. | Extreme close-up as the boy presses the glowing button. He whispers loudly, "Okay, three... two... one... ta-da!" The gadget pops open with a tiny flash, sparkling confetti, and a puff of golden smoke. The boy's eyes go huge, and the guard in the background blurts, "Huh?" | The guard laughs and steps aside. The boy gives a tiny proud bow, then tiptoes quickly through the theater door. He looks back and says with a cheeky grin, "See? I told you it was official!" The gadget gives one last little sparkle as he disappears inside.
